item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Medium Transport Pack
item_short_desc: Show your support for law enforcement with Rothco’s Thin Blue Line Medium Transport Pack. This versatile pack is made from durable heavyweight denier polyester, designed to withstand daily use and the elements. Featuring a spacious main compartment with a zippered pouch and mesh pocket, plus 3 additional zippered outer pockets, this pack offers ample storage for all your essentials. MOLLE compatibility and hydration pack readiness add to its functionality.
description: Show your support for law enforcement with Rothco’s Thin Blue Line Medium Transport Pack. This versatile pack is made from durable heavyweight denier polyester, designed to withstand daily use and the elements. Featuring a spacious main compartment with a zippered pouch and mesh pocket, plus 3 additional zippered outer pockets, this pack offers ample storage for all your essentials. MOLLE compatibility and hydration pack readiness add to its functionality. The padded back and adjustable shoulder straps include breathable mesh for comfort during extended wear. Measuring 17 inches x 10 inches x 9 inches, it’s perfect for daily use, travel, or outdoor adventures. Proceeds from this purchase benefit families of fallen first responders.
